data.name: Ghumrah
data.gender_notes: Ghumrah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'gh-m-r', which means 'to protect, guard, keep safe'. In the Islamic context, Ghumrah signifies a person who is protected, safeguarded, and shielded by Allah. The name Ghumrah carries the meaning “Protected, Secure, Safe” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ghumrah usually hope their child will grow to embody protected, secure, safe and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes safety, security, and protection, both physically and spiritually. The name Ghumrah conveys the idea of being enclosed within a fortified wall, where one feels safe from harm and the turmoil of the world.
data.etymology: Ghumrah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protected, Secure, Safe.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ghumrah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
